content:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only deploy 2026-03-02T15:02:47Z -> rolling to staging.

alice: pushing the routing/limits/timeouts patch now. No model binary changes.

ben: quick ask — are we changing per-tenant concurrency or global worker counts?

carla: per-tenant concurrency bump from 8 -> 12, default timeout 12s -> 8s for model proxy, batching params: max_batch_size 32 -> 16, max_latency_ms 40 -> 25.

carla: config snippet:
```
route_policy:
  prefer_low_cost: false
  fallback_sequence: [gptq-8b, gptq-4b]
limits:
  tenant_default_concurrency: 12
  model_proxy_timeout_ms: 8000
batching:
  max_batch_size: 16
  max_delay_ms: 25
```

dave: +1 but we need to pin canary to commit sha: a1b2c3f for 30m. If error-rate > 2% rollback automatically.

infra-ops: deploy-bot will create canary @0.05 traffic for 30m and emit metrics to #incidents and perf-dash. We also wired up a temporary alert for queue-depth > 50.

alice: added release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-02-config-only-rc1 — includes change window 15:00-16:00 PDT and rollback plan.

ben: will monitor p999 latency and token-cost; if p99 latency regresses >10% we abort and rollback.

dave: rollback steps in doc: revert config, pin previous routing policy id rp-2026-02-28, scale down concurrency to 8, re-open change window if needed.

carla: pushed to staging, running quick perf suite. Should we also lower KV cache TTL to 60s during canary to surface miss behavior?

alice: yes, set kv_cache_ttl_s=60 for canary only.

deploy-bot: Canary created: id=canary-1762104567, traffic=5%, commit=a1b2c3f, watcher=infra-ops. Will post status updates every 5m.

alice: thanks team. I'll be on standby for the 30m watch. :eyes:

ben: :thumbsup:

infra-ops: noted — will escalate to oncall if alerts trigger.

deploy-bot: Canary completed 30m. No rollback triggered. Promoting to 20% for 1h.

alice: promoting to full rollout after 1h if stable. Leaving note in the release doc.
